title: Shrinkage.
officialText:
Consideration shall be given in design to the possible effect of cross-grain dimensional changes
considered vertically which may occur in lumber fabricated in a green condition.
SECTION BC 2304
GENERAL CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS
